newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel shares hit high at 9,900 esc.
newsitem.headline: Telecel shares hit high at 9,900 esc.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel hit a new high at 9,900 escudos in trade on Lisbon bourse and dealers said the share could reach 10,000 by the end of the year.
Dealers said investors were optimistic about the performance of the company and sector.
"There is a lot of buying of Telecel, but as selling is sparse, so is liquidity," said one operator.
Another operator said: "We're going to see Telecel at 10,000 escudos by the end of the year."
A 39 percent stake in Telecel, one of two mobile phone operators in Portugal, was floated last week.
After hitting the high of 9,900 escudos, Telecel eased back to 9,850 escudos, up 150, in volume of 43,470 shares at 1053 GMT.
